items.finding: The combination of ATR-FTIR measurements and principal component analysis can serve as a useful tool for real-time reaction monitoring.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests testing ATR-FTIR coupled with multivariate data analysis to monitor active pharmaceutical ingredient variations in the polymer melt.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study monitored polysiloxane formation rather than a hot polymer extrusion melt containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient, so matrix effects and process conditions will differ.
